h5ad_contract.matrix: X, cell by feature, raw nonnegative integer-valued UMI counts
h5ad_contract.matrix_encoding: AnnData sparse or dense encoding validated structurally before access
h5ad_contract.obs_index: 10x barcode only; donor, site, and tissue labels must not be inferred from obs
h5ad_contract.var_index: Scanpy gene_symbols with make_unique=True; not used for identity
h5ad_contract.writer: author align_library.py output immediately after scanpy.read_10x_mtx(..., gex_only=False)

hashsolo_contract.accepted_classification: exact frozen MLN HTO label and singlet hypothesis only, except the frozen source-backed single-tissue assignment
hashsolo_contract.feature_detection: Antibody Capture feature IDs beginning with donor plus hyphen
hashsolo_contract.number_of_noise_barcodes: number of detected donor HTO features minus one
hashsolo_contract.pooling_order: run HashSolo independently within each H5AD except the frozen source-backed single-tissue member, retain exact MLN assignments, then pool filename-prefixed barcodes by donor

single_tissue_one_hto_exception.rule: assign every cell only when this exact member contains exactly this sole normalized donor HTO; every other member requires at least two donor HTOs
